action.title: Unpack payload.bin

param.name: img
param.title: Select partitions to extract, if none selected — all by default:

action.lock: if [[ -f $DNA_PRO/payload.bin ]]; then echo 'unlocked' else echo 'payload.bin not found' fi

param.name: BR
param.title: Select br file:
param.desc: Place your file in the project path /sdcard/DNA

param.name: DAT
param.title: Select dat file:
param.desc: Place your file in the project path /sdcard/DNA

param.name: IMG
param.title: Select img file:
param.desc: Place your file in the project path /sdcard/DNA. The tool will automatically detect the img format and unpack it (when unpacking super, only partition a files are extracted).

action.title: Unpack super

param.name: img
param.title: Select partitions to extract, if none selected — all by default:

action.lock: if [[ -f $DNA_PRO/super.img ]]; then echo 'unlocked' else echo 'super.img not found' fi

param.name: IMG_DIR
param.desc: IMG packing format will be automatically detected

param.name: Read
param.label: Read/Write permissions
param.desc: Note: only used when packing to ext4

param.name: Pack
param.label: Size
param.desc: Note: only used when packing to ext4

param.name: img_type
param.label: img format
param.desc: Note: only used when packing to ext4 or erofs

param.name: repack_from
param.label: File format
param.desc: Note: only used when packing to ext4 or erofs

param.name: brze
param.label: br compression level
param.desc: Note: the higher the value, the slower the packing process may be

param.name: erofsze
param.label: Erofs(f2fs) compression level
param.desc: Note: only used when packing to Erofs(f2fs)

param.name: type
param.label: Type
param.desc: Note: only used when packing to Erofs

param.name: test
param.label: Compress ext4 img space
param.desc: Note: only used when packing to ext4

param.name: test1
param.label: Remove avb data encryption
param.desc: Note: this switch will modify the fstab file, the operation is not universal and may cause a bootloop.

param.name: size
param.label: Total super.img size
param.desc: Enter the size of your super img, default value 8.5G.

param.name: super_group
param.label: Partition group name
param.desc: If you don't know, leave it as default.

param.name: IMG_NAME
param.title: Select IMG files to pack:
param.desc: Place your files in the project path /sdcard/DNA

param.name: IMG
param.title: Select IMG file:
param.desc: Place your file in the project path /sdcard/DNA

param.name: brze
param.label: BR compression level
param.desc: Note: the higher the value, the slower the packing process may be

param.name: IMG
param.title: Select IMG file:
param.desc: Place your file in the project path /sdcard/DNA

param.name: ZST
param.title: Select file:
param.desc: Place your file in the project path /sdcard/DNA

param.name: level
param.label: zstd compression level
param.desc: Note: the higher the value, the slower the compression!
